text:
I'm being respectful in answering, even when you're not listening and want to play a gotcha.  

It's not "reliable" when you have a hard view and bias that the low must come very close to a date. But that's not what cycles are if studied correctly.  It's like a heartbeat, it can be inconsistent.  They're a guide, when a Cycle falls comfortably within the timing its a massive edge, and when they don't you want to listen and be attentive, there is useful information to gain from it too. But for you to suggest they "are supposed to be non-negotiable" thats just wrong.  Maybe others who focus on the halving want to view it that way, but I never have and 15 yrs of tweets covering wide cycle timing on all assets shows that.
